ZAF.note: The document states nothing on AI harm rules, an authority or enforcement.
The AI Act is a committee researcher's proposal paper, not a draft text and not the committee's position; no bill or draft named.

facts.fact: South Africa's national AI policy, withdrawn by Communications Minister Solly Malatsi in April 2026, is being redrafted, with the drafting team due to submit it to the minister by 30 November 2026 and the department aiming to take it to Cabinet by March 2027.

systems.owner: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies

ZAF.note: The Information Regulator is named only as a member of a proposed AI Regulators Forum; nothing on its establishment or rulings.
